correctness.rationale: For C_0=1, C_{k+1}=mu(C_k) with mu(1)=101 and mu(0)=000, positions of ones have base-three digits 0/2, giving cyclic zero gaps g_j=3^{nu_2(j+1)} and terminal g_{2^k-1}=0. Among rotations with t exact leading zeros, only t=3^a have preceding-letter 1; lex comparison of subsequent gap sequences yields block 1^{H-1}0^{H-1}1 for H=2^{k-a-1}. Non-power groups are all-zero. One-initial group is 0^A 1 0^B with A,B>0 for k>=2. Thus exactly 2k 1-runs and 2k 0-runs, r(BWT(C_k))=4k (k>=2), with k0=1, k1=2. Fresh literal cyclic rotation sort n=3^k, k=0..5 confirmed exact numbers and blocks; infinite proof uses the gap recursion.
residual_risks: Fresh literal rotation sorts only k<=5; general claim relies on proof of lex order for all k.
